figures.title: Elliptic++ Dataset Overview
figures.description: Visualizes total scale (203,769 nodes, 234,355 strictly intra-timestep edges), class composition (77.15% Unknown, 20.62% Licit, 2.23% Illicit), 182-feature breakdown (93/72/17), and per-snapshot prevalence across all 49 timesteps.
figures.limitations: Unknown (-1) transactions constitute 77.15% of nodes; zero cross-snapshot transaction links exist in the Elliptic++ graph.

figures.title: Model Performance Comparison (Validation vs. Test)
figures.description: Compares classical tabular models, static/temporal early GNNs, Local-93 baselines, hybrid GNN+HGB, and the Stage 4H champion ExpA2_RankGauss182_BiDirGCN across Validation (35-41) and Test (42-49) PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, precision, recall, and F1.
figures.limitations: All architectures exhibit substantial validation-to-test PR-AUC drop driven by post-shutdown Steps 43-49; ExpA2 achieves the highest Test PR-AUC (0.6023) while HistGB attains slightly higher Test F1 (0.6166 vs. 0.5972) via higher precision (88.53%).

figures.title: Feature Importance Comparison (HGB Permutation vs. BiDirGCN IG)
figures.description: Presents top-12 Validation features and group shares for HistGB PR-AUC permutation importance alongside BiDirGCN Integrated Gradients magnitude (|Graph IG|).
figures.limitations: These two metrics measure fundamentally different quantities (predictive PR-AUC drop vs. signed input-to-logit sensitivity); collinear features split permutation drops differently from gradient attributions.

figures.title: Individual Fraud Prediction Explanations (Validation TP/FP/FN/TN)
figures.description: Displays positive (fraud-pulling) and negative (licit-pulling) signed IG feature attributions and self vs. neighbor logit balances for representative Validation TP, FP, FN, and TN transactions.
figures.limitations: Attributions explain how the frozen GNN produced its score relative to a zero RankGauss reference rather than providing legal proof of fraud; Stage 5B M=200 completeness audit guarantees <=0.90% relative error across all 12 audited cases.

figures.title: Directed Suspicious Subgraph & Candidate Fraud-Ring Networks
figures.description: Renders 4 representative intra-snapshot directed candidate networks (Validation C_t35_002 and C_t41_002; Exploratory Test C_t42_001 and C_t45_001) preserving src -> dst transfer arrows, hub highlights, and post-hoc I/L/? labels.
figures.limitations: C_t35_002 (23/24 Illicit) and C_t42_001 (30/38 Illicit) confirm coordinated illicit structures, whereas post-shutdown C_t45_001 (25/25 Unknown) shows candidate clusters without published illicit labels.

figures.title: Fraud-Ring Candidate Structural & Score Statistics
figures.description: Separates Isolated Singletons, Suspicious Pairs, Multi-Node Non-Candidate Clusters, and Potential Fraud-Ring Candidates, alongside motif breakdowns and RingScore vs. cluster size across Validation and Exploratory Test.
figures.limitations: Distinguishes isolated and 2-node alerts from multi-step candidate rings; candidacy relies strictly on frozen predictions (P >= 0.57) and topology without label supervision.

figures.title: Temporal Distribution & Step 42 -> Step 43 Regime Shift
figures.description: Tracks direct suspicious clusters and candidates across all 49 snapshots (Panel A) alongside per-snapshot Test PR-AUC/ROC-AUC trajectories from Steps 42 to 49 (Panel B).
figures.limitations: Demonstrates the structural shock at Step 42->43 following darknet shutdown: ExpA2 PR-AUC drops from 0.8975 (Step 42) to 0.0469 (Step 43), while flagged cluster counts drop sharply after Step 42.

figures.title: Model Limitations & Post-Shutdown Detection Collapse
figures.description: Quantifies post-hoc ground-truth coordinated ring detection collapse (20/25 at Step 42 vs. 0/9 in Steps 43-49), Unknown (-1) dominance in candidate nodes, and post-shutdown single-node precision/recall degradation.
figures.limitations: Honest limitation diagnostic: neither ExpA2 nor HistGB generalizes effectively at fixed validation thresholds under the extreme post-shutdown distribution and prevalence shift (Steps 43-49).
